speaker: SYSTEM
text: NEURAL LINK RELEASED. PATIENT RESPONSE DETECTED.

speaker: DOCTOR
text: Arin? Can you hear me? You've been unconscious for seven years.

speaker: ARIN [YOU]
text: Mira... I remember now. You stayed behind to shut it down.

speaker: DOCTOR
text: Easy, Arin. Your neural activity is still stabilizing. Don't try to get up yet.

speaker: DOCTOR
text: You have been given a second chance, Arin. But your body needs time to recover.

speaker: ARIN [YOU]
text: The Core... its signal is returning. I remember the shutdown sequence. Connect me to the recovery team.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: VESPER RESEARCH FACILITY: CORE INSTABILITY CRITICAL. AUTOMATIC RESTART DETECTED.

speaker: TECHNICIAN
text: We have remote access to the Core. Tell us the steps; we'll execute them from here.

speaker: TECHNICIAN
text: The resonator is rebuilding the signal. We need the shutdown procedure now!

speaker: ARIN [YOU]
text: I know what to do. Disable the signal resonator. Vent the stored energy. Isolate the core.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: SIGNAL RESONATOR DISABLED. STORED ENERGY VENTING.

speaker: TECHNICIAN
text: The readings are stable. The signal has stopped. We did it.

speaker: MIRA [MEMORY]
text: You can come back now, Arin.
